snippet.title: No Man's Sky COSMOS Deep Dive
snippet.description:
Introducing..No Man's Sky COSMOS (Update 7.0)

Sean describes how the 10th Anniversary COSMOS update completely overhauls space exploration by introducing customisable space stations, star bases, salvageable space hulks, asteroid fields, alliances and much, much more.

Full patch notes here: https://www.nomanssky.com/cosmos-update
